trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Collect the other 54 trophies; multiplayer and DLC are not needed.
Check the PS5 trophy list when your last remaining objective is complete.

trophies.guide: Finish every other exhibit in this vault to unlock the platinum automatically. [1][2]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play Jason's opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Continue the story; this unlock is automatic.

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission as Jason. No separate cleanup is required. [1][4]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1 and begin What's in the Bag? in Chapter 2.
The story transition awards this automatically.

trophies.guide: Advance into Chapter 2; the official target is Chapter 1, despite GameTrek's offset numbering. [1][2][18]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2 and start Welcome to Vice City.
Let the automatic story award register at the Chapter 3 transition.

trophies.guide: The asterisks belong to the official name. Complete Chapter 2, not Chapter 3. [1][2]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3 and continue into Chapter 4.
Complete Ocean Beach and Another Life to reach the unlock.

trophies.guide: Keep playing after the chapter transition through the first two Chapter 4 missions. [1][4]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Follow the main story through Chapter 4.
Finish Starting From Zero, the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Starting From Zero closes Chapter 4 and awards this story trophy. [1]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Complete the final story mission in Chapter 5.
Use post-credit free roam for the remaining collection.

trophies.guide: The official description specifies the final mission. Cleanup remains available after the credits. [2][1][4]

trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Reach Breakfast Run in the Chapter 2 main story.
Finish that mission for the automatic award.

trophies.guide: Follow the Chapter 2 story through Breakfast Run. [1][4]

trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Progress to The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the main mission to receive the trophy.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a main-story unlock in Chapter 3. [1][4]

trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Reach Child's Play during Chapter 4.
Finish the mission; no optional objective is needed.

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play on the Chapter 4 story path. [1][4]

trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 until Headliners becomes available.
Complete Headliners for the automatic unlock.

trophies.guide: This is awarded by the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. [1][4]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Follow Chapter 4 to VCIA Takedown.
Finish the mission to add this story trophy.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown awards this automatically during Chapter 4. [1][4]

trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission as part of the main story.

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory on the final chapter's story path. [1][4]

trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Earlier progress carries over.
Target 100 optional missions, 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies, 15 meditations, 70 challenges and 300 stunts. Finish all robbery, underwater, range, drone and Bret deck objectives.

trophies.guide: Follow the game's completion checklist rather than clearing every map icon. This is the longest and hardest platinum requirement. [1][4][8]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Choose any 250 of 397 stunts; under-bridge flights are a quick option.
Track regional totals in Progress > Activities > Stunts; continue to 300 for 100%.

trophies.guide: Mix jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. The trophy threshold is 250, while completion needs 300. [1][4]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Try fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Score a basketball basket and consult Progress > Activities for missing types.

trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity categories while traveling between story objectives. [1][4]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Win gold in all 42 challenges across 12 ranges.
Use range practice to improve Focus for Gunslinger. See D4 for the two-location discrepancy.

trophies.guide: Track medals rather than just venue visits: all 42 must be gold. The vault follows the 12-range consensus. [1][4][18]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Win once at each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
Clear all 42 time trials eventually for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: One win per location satisfies this trophy; all races are a separate completion requirement. [1][4]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Win 20 distinct races from the 40 available; repeats do not add credit.
Check Progress > Activities > Racing and extend to 30 wins for 100%.

trophies.guide: Choose new race events each time and record distinct wins. [1][4]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Meet Cal in Feng Shui in Chapter 1, then follow his text to the purple fishing icon west of Key Lento.
Bring a boat with a rod; Push Square reports a Parrotfish heavier than 2 kg for his challenge.

trophies.guide: Work through Cal's fishing requests and beat his challenge when offered. [1][4][3]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Choose Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
Finish every level of that one game; its extra challenges are unnecessary.

trophies.guide: Use the home TV or an arcade cabinet and reach one game's ending. [1][4]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: As Lucia in Chapter 3, follow Andy's call and text to Belville.
Finish his jobs through Puff Puff Pass; they remain open after the story.

trophies.guide: Lucia receives Andy's strand. Follow it through the final job in post-story free roam if needed. [1][4]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, dive at Kenton's marked shipwrecks, use the detector and return the treasure.
Wait for Jason's later texts in Chapters 2–3; follow Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.guide: Kenton's seven wreck sites span several chapters; a pause in his messages is expected. [1][4]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, visit Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish Billy's five jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes; post-story cleanup is available.

trophies.guide: Take Billy's jobs in order from Thrillbillies through Hometown Heroes. [1][4]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Finish eight qualifying strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Verify other strands with the trophy counter; the full list is unresolved.

trophies.guide: Use the in-game trophy counter to confirm qualifying completions. All strands remain after the story, and this trophy is separate from 100%. [1][4]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3, then deliver Randy's 16 requested sports cars to the RK garage in west Vice City.
Scan sports cars in east Vice City and Ocean Beach with WAiNK to identify wanted models.

trophies.guide: Work down Randy's wish list after unlocking his garage deliveries. [1][4]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: As Jason, complete Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 and attack the purple Synthetic Lab markers.
Continue Take Out Kitty Litter until Tyrone offers Spin On This, then finish it.

trophies.guide: Destroy labs for Tyrone until his closing mission becomes available. [1][4]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Protect the run first: in Chapter 1, follow Lucia onto Jason's balcony when she suggests meditation and accept the optional activity. This balcony becomes inaccessible later.
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Using both characters can add two credits; inspect Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The balcony's necessity is unconfirmed. Keep a Chapter 1 save; the final shared meditation requires Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Possible missable: do the Chapter 1 balcony session as a precaution, then finish the map's meditation spots with both characters. The disputed balcony requirement is recorded in D1. [1][4][5][8]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, follow Bret Vogel's text as Jason to Veteran Hunted in Lummox County and fulfill his hunting requests.
Use his Killtelligence SM-69 rifle from a weapon locker. The exact trigger animal is unconfirmed; finishing 15 Target Decks may cover it, but is not a verified trigger.

trophies.guide: Follow Bret's requests, but do not assume a specific animal is confirmed. Check the trophy after each delivery. [1][5]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Complete any three of the 18 card sets.
Selling cards at pawn shops retains credit; continue to 15 sets for 100%.

trophies.guide: Prioritize sets close to completion. Sold cards still count. [3][4]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: Open WAiNK with Up then R1 and scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher Tags.
Reach 100 recorded locations in Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.guide: Any 100 eligible location scans meet both this trophy and the corresponding completion target. [1][3][4]

trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Select achievable tasks in Progress > Challenges and complete 50 of 80.
Keep going to 70 for 100%; ten difficult challenges can be skipped.

trophies.guide: Work through easier challenges first and inspect the progress menu between sessions. [1][4]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner with Right + Triangle and reach four wanted stars together.
Escape the heat zone on a fast bike or through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia; Chapter 4 vault jobs also create four stars.

trophies.guide: Keep your partner with you throughout a four-star escape. [1]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, bring your partner, armor, healing items and sticky bombs to three robbery targets.
Keep the wanted level between shops. Try north Vice City's jewelry cluster after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; wait about 30 seconds after the third or rob a fourth.

trophies.guide: Chain three shops without letting the wanted level clear; allow time for the delayed award. [1][5]

trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Scan traffic using WAiNK, or enter vehicles, until 100 are discovered.
Continue scanning base models: the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277.

trophies.guide: Scanning from a busy roadside is enough; you do not have to drive every model. [1][3]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Prepare armor, an assault rifle and Focus buffs; gather five gang enemies at a Gang Operation.
Aim and press L3 + R3, then down all five within one Focus use. Gang members count; police, civilians and soldiers reportedly do not.

trophies.guide: Raise Focus through activities first, ideally to level 4, then attempt a five-enemy burst at a gang site. [1]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: At VCIA terminals E3/E4, use the boarding-bridge stairs to enter a docked passenger plane's cockpit.
Reverse onto the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away.

trophies.guide: Choose a plane connected to a terminal bridge rather than a loose airfield plane. [1]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Enter Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest Mariana County island via the gate or southeast stunt jump.
Take a tank from the base's south side and fire at enemies until awarded.

trophies.guide: Steal and use a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station. [1]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to obtain the Snap Gun; use it quietly on a jewelry shop's back door.
Find the safe code, empty the safe, erase footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a suggested site; leave quietly.

trophies.guide: Avoid kicking the door. The silent entry tool and security cleanup keep the robbery undetected. [1]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Complete That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4; follow the security van and rob the open vault with your partner.
Buy further van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 and escape five of the eight vault jobs. A fast motorcycle helps with four-star heat.

trophies.guide: This exhibit is Silver per PSN and the broad consensus. Finish five vault escapes after the introductory job. [2][1][4]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: The Chapter 4 optional job That's Where The Money Is… can award this along its vault robbery.
For an earlier attempt, block an armored truck near a bank, blast its rear door with a sticky bomb and escape the heat radius.

trophies.guide: Rob the truck and finish the escape, or combine it with the Chapter 4 vault introduction. [1]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Use a plane to cross every black-fog area on the map.
Inspect the whole map for gaps until all terrain is revealed.

trophies.guide: Fly systematic passes to remove the remaining map fog. [1][5]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Find the yellow nearby operation markers and rob one operation from each of nine gangs.
Check Progress > Gangs; all 39 operations are needed eventually for 100%.

trophies.guide: Count unique gangs, not repeated robberies against the same gang. [1][5]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Visit Ocean View Rooftop Bar and purchase an Apple Martini.
Drink beside the bar. This detailed method is PowerPyx-only; older sixshore and KeenGamer guides left it unresolved.

trophies.guide: Try PowerPyx's Apple Martini method, with single-source confidence clearly noted. [1][5][8]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS and find the south Vice City showroom.
Steal its blue Banshee, break through the window and drive away. Other cars are not reported to qualify; the detailed method has one source.

trophies.guide: Use the blue Banshee specifically and allow the award to register after reaching the street. [1]

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: During Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 or its later respawn, loot the southeast office watch, northeast table Gutterball shotgun and northeast hallway safe.
Open the safe with sticky bombs and escape the police. The three valuables can be collected over separate visits.

trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn, and complete the escape. [1]

trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness-club membership and call your partner to train together.
Max Strength for Jason and Lucia simultaneously; check the heart statistic in the character menu.

trophies.guide: Shared workouts progress both characters. This trophy is hidden according to PSN; see D5. [1][2][4]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Accumulate 500 criminal-profile actions during robberies and hostile encounters.
Enable Criminal Profile HUD notifications and inspect the trophy counter; extreme profiles make police immediately hostile.

trophies.guide: Track profile-affecting actions as the run progresses; normal crime cleanup should supply many of them. [1]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: After Credit Check in Chapter 3, take Lucia alone to the Little Cuba Payday Loans in Vice City.
Aim at the teller, steal the cash and flee on foot until the delayed award appears. This method is detailed by PowerPyx alone.

trophies.guide: Leave Jason behind and stay on foot after the robbery. [1]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: Go alone northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM and look for a blinking roadside car; leave and return if absent.
Follow the blue light into the woods, approach the UFO, talk to the dropped woman, offer help and return to her car. Spawn timing is random and the method is single-source.

trophies.guide: Retry the roadside spawn on another pass if needed; complete the whole encounter rather than just finding the light. [1]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: Ride a bike into a crowded district such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Use Square to kick ten pedestrians within 60 seconds. PowerPyx supplies the detailed method; older guides left it unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Prepare a dense route before starting the timed bike-kick sequence. [1]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans.
Fence marked bills, ideally with Yasmani in Vice City, until cumulative laundering reaches $250,000; Chapter 4 vaults provide large hauls.

trophies.guide: The total accumulates across robberies, so combine laundering with the completion route. [1]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops.
Use expensive guns, modifications and tattoos to advance the total quickly.

trophies.guide: Shop spending accumulates across store types. Plan purchases around useful gear and upgrades. [1]

trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open Vice City Real Estate and buy all eight purchasable garages for $160,000 total.
Exclude the four story garages; fund purchases with later robberies.

trophies.guide: Buy the eight optional garages rather than counting story-owned properties. [1]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: After Moses in Chapter 2 installs Scooter Bros, buy garage spaces and bring stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; choose Respray and Register.
Start with cheap tracker-free vehicles. Chapter 3 permits Standard Tracker registrations at Pay 'n' Sprays; reach ten registrations.

trophies.guide: Secure parking first and use inexpensive cars or bikes to limit registration costs. [1]

disagreements.title: The balcony precaution
disagreements.text: Possibly one missable [1][4][5][8][9][13][16]; none known [3]; uncertain [2]. Call: treat #28 as missable, although the Chapter 1 balcony requirement remains unconfirmed.

disagreements.title: A 200-hour collection
disagreements.text: About 200 h [1][4][8][9], 200–250+ [5], versus 250+/300 h [3]. Call: about 200 hours; allow up to 300 per Push Square. Tom West's 80+ review hours with 20 achievements is reported through [5].

disagreements.title: Maximum Withdrawal is Silver
disagreements.text: PSN via [2] and 13 other sources say Silver; [3] alone says Bronze. Call: Silver, preserving the 1/2/6/46 split.

disagreements.title: 42 medals, 12 ranges
disagreements.text: 12 ranges / 42 challenges [1][4][18]; two named locations [3]. Call: 12 ranges and 42 challenges; named venues may explain the differing location count.

disagreements.title: 28 hidden exhibits
disagreements.text: 28 hidden [2][4][5][6]; [3] omits Personal Best's hidden flag. Call: #47 is hidden, giving 27 visible and 28 hidden.

disagreements.title: The final mission
disagreements.text: PSN [2] says complete the final mission for #7; [6] paraphrases Chapter 5. Call: retain the official final-mission wording.

disagreements.title: Gamerscore is not flat
disagreements.text: Varied TrueAchievements-sourced values [2][4][5] conflict with flat Silver 50G / Bronze 10G [17]. Call: prefer varied values; this PS5 vault does not display Gamerscore. [13] also notes mismatches.

disagreements.title: Discard the 36-trophy split
disagreements.text: [10] claims 1P/3G/14S/18B, summing to 36, and calls The Shootist Bronze. Call: disregard those grades; use the 55-trophy 1P/2G/6S/46B consensus.

disagreements.title: Chapter numbers retained
disagreements.text: [18] calls Paradise Lost Chapter 2 and T**s Ass Drug Money Chapter 3. Call: use PSN Chapters 1 and 2 respectively [1][2][4].

disagreements.title: Eight qualifying strands
disagreements.text: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count [1][4]. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Other qualifying strands are still being confirmed. Call: verify with the in-game trophy counter.
